formal_shuffle_positive_axis_replay.conditional_statement: After a start cell is already selected and X/Y are taken as nearest-center positive-axis transitions, every formal shuffle word is a valid sequence of nearest-center center-to-center moves.

native_origin_replay.N0_counterexample: D_0={(0,0)} gives the empty formal word, but O_E is a coordinate vertex rather than a circle-cell state.
native_origin_replay.reason: O_E is not a cell; an origin-incidence/start-cell operator is required before any center-transition word, and the foundation does not supply the incident-cell-to-absolute-address affine map.

general_graph_distance.for_a_b_nonnegative: carrier graph distance from a selected center to a*t1+b*t2 is max(a,b)
general_graph_distance.proof_lower_bound: each allowed carrier step changes each of the two (t1,t2) coefficients by at most 1
general_graph_distance.proof_upper_bound: min(a,b) diagonal (-t3) steps plus |a-b| steps on the larger active axis

smallest_positive_interior_counterexampl.reason: -t3=t1+t2 is a carrier translation relation; C and C-t3 are nearest centers
